source_file: F&B Controller audit platform/Super Admin Flow.dc.html
extraction_notes: No schema/design-spec.schema.json was found anywhere in this repo (checked project root and via glob for **/*.schema.json). Proceeded using the structure implied by the design-extraction process steps (screens, unresolved_style_bindings, flagged_unreferenced_bindings, data_shapes, state_machine, calculations, design_tokens). If a schema file is added later, this file should be re-validated/reshaped against it.

This single .dc.html models THREE role-scoped portals behind one top-level {{role}} state toggle: 'auditor' (showAuditor), 'super' (showSuper — the Super Admin surface this extraction focuses on), and 'restaurant' (showRestaurant — a client/outlet-facing preview). All three are documented below because they share state and because two of the three role-switch entry points are themselves dead code (see flagged_unreferenced_bindings) — a build agent needs to know the Restaurant portal has no reachable UI toggle in this file, not that it doesn't exist.
Per CLAUDE.md precedence, inline style values below are copied verbatim from the file, not invented.

computeMetrics(defs, vals).description: Pure derivation over a template's metric definitions and an audit's entered MTD values. All figures are month-to-date only (no day-wise entry) per the 'MTD period' field.

outputs.covers: sum of all metrics in section 'covers' (e.g. No of Pax)
outputs.netSale: sum of all metrics in section 'sales'
outputs.totalDiscounts: sum of all metrics in section 'discount'
outputs.totalTaxes: sum of 'tax' section metrics where kind!=='charge'
outputs.totalCharges: sum of 'tax' section metrics where kind==='charge' (i.e. Service Charge is a 'charge', SGST/CGST/VAT are 'tax')
outputs.grossSale: netSale + totalCharges + totalTaxes − totalDiscounts (all treated as 0 if unset, EXCEPT the whole result is null only if netSale, totalTaxes, totalCharges AND totalDiscounts are ALL null)
outputs.barCost: sum of 'cost' section metrics where group==='bar'
outputs.kitchenCost: sum of 'cost' section metrics where group==='kitchen'
outputs.ncCost: sum of 'cost' section metrics where group==='nc'

per_row_derived_display.APC (average per cover): value / covers, only computed if covers is truthy (non-null, non-zero)
per_row_derived_display.metricDen resolution: den==='net'→netSale, den==='bar'→barSale, den==='kitchen'→kitchenSale, else looks up c.byId[den] (a specific other metric's raw value)

computeMetrics(defs, vals).currency_formatting: fmtINR(n): Indian digit grouping (lakhs/crores comma style, e.g. ₹1,65,151), rounds to nearest whole rupee, returns '—' for null/undefined, prefixes '-₹' for negative. NOTE: this hand-rolled formatter groups digits Indian-style but does NOT use the short-scale abbreviation (₹4.80L) that CLAUDE.md's coding conventions mandate ('Indian short-scale (₹4.80L) via one formatter') — flag this as a design-vs-doc discrepancy to reconcile when implementing, not something to silently resolve either way.

calculations.metricSections(...): Groups computeMetrics() output into UI sections in a fixed order: Covers → MTD Total Net Sale (with per-row APC) → Discounts → Charges & Taxes (ends with TOTAL GROSS SALE) → Costing (bar cost rows, TOTAL BAR COST, kitchen cost rows, TOTAL KITCHEN COST, TOTAL F&B COST, nc cost rows, TOTAL NET F&B COST). Each section is only included if it has at least one matching metric definition.

checklist_progress.selDone/selTotal: count of items with status!=='pending' out of all items
checklist_progress.mtdComplete: true only if every metric definition id has a non-null numeric value entered
checklist_progress.submitDisabled: !(selDone===selTotal && mtdComplete) — auditor cannot submit until every checklist item is answered AND every MTD metric is filled
checklist_progress.group_scoreLabel: Math.round(passed/scored*100)+'% pass' where scored = items with status pass or fail (observation and na are excluded from the pass-rate denominator); 'Not scored yet' if scored===0

AI classify/polish (report generation).classify(text): Keyword-matches the item's label+remark (lowercased) against a fixed 10-rule CATEGORY_RULES table (temperature/cold→'Temperature & Expiry' Critical..High, raw/cross-contamination→'Food Safety Risk' Critical, label/fifo/expiry→'Inventory Control' High, hygiene/clean/grease→'Hygiene Standards' High, waste/bin/pest→'Statutory Compliance' Medium, fire/extinguisher→'Statutory Compliance' Critical, bill/void→'Revenue Control' High, discount/comp→'Revenue Control' Medium, cancel/reason code→'Revenue Control' High, stock/purchase/invoice/vendor/gst→'Inventory Control' Medium); falls back to 'Operational Control' Medium if no keyword matches.
AI classify/polish (report generation).polish(item, evidenceCount): Rewrites the auditor's raw remark into report prose: capitalizes first letter, strips trailing punctuation/whitespace, appends 'Checkpoint meets the documented standard.' for pass items or ', observed during the walkthrough.' for others, and appends an evidence-corroboration sentence if photos/files are attached. Returns a fixed 'No remark recorded...' sentence if the remark was empty. This is the concrete implementation this design file uses for CLAUDE.md's 'Remarks are AI-polished on submit' invariant — note the ACTUAL polish trigger in this file is 'Generate report' in sReview (enhanceAll/enhanceItem), not literally at auditor submit time; reconcile this design-vs-doc timing difference (ADR-0004/UX-010) rather than assuming the doc's 'at submit' wording is exactly how this canvas models it.
AI classify/polish (report generation).severity/impact/correctiveAction/sla/own: Only populated for non-pass items (status!=='pass'); pass items get these all cleared to null/''. Existing item-level values always win over the CATEGORY_RULES default (it.severity || r.sev, etc).

All fully computed per auditor row in decorateItems-equivalent (auditorRows in renderVals), but the expanded 'Manage' card in markup only renders the password block and the remove-confirmation block (lines ~636-680). This is a strict-tier screen, so this gap is called out with elevated importance per extraction rules: outlet access control, suspend/reactivate, forced reset, and force-sign-out are all real product capabilities implied by CLAUDE.md's admin-auth section ('Sessions are signed-cookie and admin-revocable ("end all sessions")', 'admin sets/resets passwords') that this design canvas computed but never surfaced. Confirm with the design owner whether these are missing markup (build them) or intentionally deferred before treating as in-scope.

exportPdf is wired to a button in sReview; exportCsv and exportHtml are defined identically but have no corresponding button anywhere. doPublish is defined and would set an audit to 'published', but sDetail (the natural home for a Publish action, given shareLink in sReview already does an equivalent publish-and-copy-link action) has no Publish button in its markup. Likely represents CSV/HTML export and a plain-publish (as opposed to publish+share-link) as intended-but-unbuilt actions — confirm before spec'ing as required.

Exposed in renderVals() output but never called from markup — the two wired equivalents are addBuilderItemToCat(cid) (used by each department's 'Add Checklist Point' button) and addBuilderCat() (used by 'Add Department', which seeds a new department with one blank item). addBuilderItem() would add a bare item with cat:'Uncategorised' outside of any existing department grouping and is likely superseded/leftover.

Computed headline counts (total auditors, active count, suspended count, count with a still-pending invite/temp-password) with no matching summary-stat UI anywhere on the sAuditors screen. Strict-tier screen — flagging explicitly per extraction rules rather than omitting.

Defined in the Component class but not even included in the renderVals() return object — it is unreachable from markup by construction (markup can only bind to keys renderVals() returns). Appears to be dead/leftover logic, not a feature gap.

State fields and handlers exist for what looks like a 'remember me' checkbox, a second verification-code step, and a self-service password-reset confirmation step, but the markup only ever renders the slCredsStep block (which renderVals() hardcodes to always-true: `slCredsStep: true`). No 'Forgot password?' link, remember-me checkbox, or code-entry UI exists anywhere in the login screen markup. Confirm before building a multi-step/2FA login — the current design shows single-step email+password only.

If the intent was an 'Active' badge/dot on the current month's pill (the pill's own label text does already append ' (Active)' literally, so this may be intentionally redundant/leftover), confirm before adding any visual marker here.

informational_notes: sSuperApp's condition `s.role!=='super' || s.superAuthed` has an unreachable-in-context first disjunct: it is only ever evaluated nested inside `<sc-if value="{{showSuper}}">`, which itself requires `s.role==='super'`, making `s.role!=='super'` always false at that point. Functionally the binding just reduces to `s.superAuthed`. Not a bug to fix, just worth knowing when tracing the condition rather than assuming role-switching logic is more complex than it is.
CLAUDE.md's 'Calculated is never typed — derivable figures are read-only everywhere' is faithfully modeled: every derivedRow() in metricSections() has isInput:false, isDerived:true and no onChange.

CLAUDE.md's 'N/A is neither fail nor blank — needs a reason, excluded from compliance %' is faithfully modeled: group.scoreLabel's pass-rate denominator (`scored`) filters to status pass|fail only, excluding both 'observation' and 'na' from the percentage.

fmtINR() groups digits Indian-style (lakh/crore commas) but does not abbreviate to short-scale (₹4.80L) — this conflicts with the literal wording of CLAUDE.md's coding-conventions line on currency formatting. Flagged under calculations.computeMetrics for reconciliation, not resolved here.
